about.alhamdulillahBody: All praise is due to Allah for blessing us with the opportunity to serve His Book and the Ummah. We are deeply grateful for being chosen to develop this platform that connects people with the beautiful recitation of the Holy Quran.
about.missionBody: {{appName}} is dedicated to making the beautiful recitation of the Holy Quran accessible to everyone. We strive to provide a serene and intuitive experience for listening to the Quran, featuring the world's most renowned reciters and a few {{appName}} Exclusives.

about.commitmentBody: We are committed to continuous improvement and maintaining the highest standards of quality. Our team works diligently to ensure that {{appName}} remains a reliable and respectful platform for Quranic recitation. InshaAllah, with the help of Allah, we will continue to develop and enhance these features to better serve the Ummah. We are grateful for your support and feedback as we continue this blessed journey together.

credits.intro: {{appName}} wouldn't be possible without the incredible work of these projects, organizations, and individuals. We're deeply grateful for their contributions to the Muslim community and the tech world.

items.qul: Advanced Quranic data and word-level information by Tarteel
items.quranFoundation: Comprehensive Quran API services by Quran.com
items.alafasy: Morning and evening adhkar, Quranic duas and more Hisn al-Muslim adhkar
items.removal: Rights holders can request the removal of any content through {{supportUrl}}.
items.wikipediaNames: 99 Names meanings by Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0
items.fitrahive: Transliterations of three morning and evening adhkar, MIT License
items.svgrepo: Beautiful open source icons and illustrations
items.uthmani: Beautiful Quranic font from Arabic Fonts
items.betaTesters: For their valuable feedback and suggestions
items.community: For their continuous support and guidance

mushafSettings.title: Mushaf Settings
mushafSettings.translationSource: Using: Saheeh International Translation with footnotes
mushafSettings.highlightAllahHelper: Highlights Allah's name and divine title forms like Rabb in the mushaf.
mushafSettings.rewayahDisabled: Rewayah switching is disabled in Mushaf 1440 beta.
mushafSettings.qcfBetaMessage: Mushaf 1440 is {{appName}}’s most modern mushaf pipeline, but it is still in beta. Tajweed coloring is available as a preview. Rewayah switching is still disabled.

legendSummary.shubah: Flags words that differ from Hafs. Letter-level tajweed rules are not highlighted for this rewayah.
legendSummary.ibnKathir: Flags words that differ from Hafs and highlights Ibn Kathir's silah (pronoun lengthening). Letter-level tajweed rules are not highlighted.
legendSummary.nafi: Highlights the published-mushaf rules KFGQPC encodes: tashil, ibdal, madd al-badal, taghliz al-lam, silah, and genuine word variants. Taqlil, tarqiq ar-ra, and naql are not yet supported.
legendSummary.abuAmr: Flags only genuine letter-level word variants from Hafs. Abu Amr-specific tajweed rules (idgham kabeer, imalah) are not yet highlighted.

taghliz.label: Taghliz al-Lam
taghliz.description: Heavy lam in Allah after emphatic letters

descriptions.wordVariant: Word that reads differently from Hafs
descriptions.silahDifference: Pronoun-lengthening mark (ۥ / ۦ) that differs from Hafs

summary.words: Tints words that read differently from Hafs. Pronunciation rules such as tashil, imalah and taqlil are not highlighted.
summary.wordsAndSilah: Tints words that read differently from Hafs and colors silah marks. Pronunciation rules such as tashil, imalah and taqlil are not highlighted.

mushafSettings.hafsOnlyFont: Hafs only. This font lacks marks used by {{rewayah}}.

fallback.title: Couldn't load {{rewayah}}
fallback.body: Hafs is shown instead. {{rewayah}} stays your rewayah and is tried again the next time the app opens.

mushafSettings.communityReflectionsHelper: Show community reflections under each ayah in list view
mushafSettings.indopakHafsOnly: IndoPak shows Hafs only. Choosing another rewayah switches the font to {{font}}.
